why: The pink triangle moves clockwise around the 8 parts of the box, jumping 2 places, then 1 place, then 2 places again: left-bottom -> top-left (2 places) -> top-right (1 place) -> right-bottom (2 places). That is option 1. Options 2 and 4 only repeat earlier positions.
note: Moves are +2, +1 then +3 places clockwise to reach the book answer A; a clean rule is not obvious.
